maize.name: Maize (mealies)
maize.notes: SA staple. Dryland needs 500-750 mm/yr; frost-free period of 120-140 days. Base temp 10C (Grain SA). HU to 50% tassel ~685-735 for dryland cultivars.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.notes: Winter and summer rainfall areas; dryland western Cape plus irrigated. Base temp 4.4C (IFAS).

sunflower.name: Sunflower
sunflower.notes: Drought tolerant; widely grown in North West and Free State. Seedlings tolerate light frost. Base temp 7.2C (IFAS).

soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.notes: Fast-growing sector in Mpumalanga/KZN. Base temp 10C. GDD to maturity varies 1200-1800 by maturity group.

groundnut.name: Groundnut (peanut)
groundnut.notes: Needs warm sandy loam; frost kills. Base temp 13.3C (IFAS).

sorghum.name: Grain sorghum
sorghum.notes: Very drought/heat tolerant; good for hotter, drier west. Very frost sensitive. Base temp 10C.

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane
sugarcane.notes: KZN and Mpumalanga Lowveld. Long 12-18 month cycle; base temps 12-20C by stage (SASRI). Frost kills tops.

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.notes: Needs 500-650 mm minimum, usually irrigated. Base temp 15.6C (IFAS). Frost kills bolls.

canola.name: Canola
canola.notes: Western Cape rotation crop with wheat. Base temp 4.4C (IFAS).

barley.name: Malting barley
barley.notes: Southern Cape malting barley for the brewing industry. Base temp 4.4C.

potato.name: Potato
potato.notes: Grown in many SA regions (Sandveld, Free State, Limpopo). Usually irrigated. Base temp 7.2C (IFAS).

dry_beans.name: Dry beans
dry_beans.notes: Mpumalanga, Free State, North West. Sensitive to frost and excess rain at harvest.

rooibos.name: Rooibos tea
rooibos.notes: Endemic to Cederberg/Sandveld, Western Cape. Needs Mediterranean climate, winter rain 250-450 mm/yr, sandy acidic soil.

grapes.name: Wine grapes
grapes.notes: Winkler index base 10C; GDD to ripen ~1400-1700. Winter dormant vines frost-hardy; spring frost damages shoots.

citrus.name: Citrus (oranges etc.)
citrus.notes: Subtropical; fruit damaged below -2C. Major export from Limpopo, Mpumalanga, Eastern/Western Cape. Usually irrigated.

macadamia.name: Macadamia
macadamia.notes: Subtropical tree crop, KZN and Mpumalanga Lowveld. Needs ~1000-1500 mm/yr, frost-free.

avocado.name: Avocado
avocado.notes: Subtropical; Limpopo, KZN, Mpumalanga. Sensitive to frost and wind; needs ~1000 mm/yr.

lucerne.name: Lucerne (alfalfa)
lucerne.notes: Main irrigated fodder crop; deep-rooted and drought tolerant but responds strongly to irrigation. Base temp 5C (41F).

oats.name: Oats
oats.notes: Cool-season grain and grazing crop. Base temp 4.4C.

rye.name: Rye
rye.notes: Most winter-hardy cereal; used for grazing and cover crops in SA.
